answer_1.quote: Text style transfer (TST) aims to modify the style of a given text while preserving its underlying content

answer_2.quote: We evaluate content preservation using BLEU score and embedding similarity against the input sentences. We use Sentence-BERT and cosine similarity for the embedding similarity. We use GPT-2's perplexity to estimate fluency.

answer_4.quote: We also run a small-scale in-house human evaluation on a random sample of 100 sentences from the test set
answer_4.guideline: Outputs are rated on a 5-point Likert scale for style transfer accuracy, content preservation, and fluency.
